Misc. Criminal Case No. 29338 of 2024

Bhoora @ Satendra Giri
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others

Appearance:
 Shri Rohit Singh Patel - Advocate for the applicant.

Shri Mohan Sausarkar - Public Prosecutor for the responde
 Order
This is the first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

2. The applicant has been arrested on 22.06.2024 by Police Station Dindori, District Dindori (M.P.)
in connection with Crime No.474/2024 for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366Ka,
376(3), 376(2)(N) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 5L and 6 of the POCSO Act, 2012.
3. It is submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the case and he has not committed any offence in any manner.
This application has been filed on the ground that present applicant and victim were have love relations.
The applicant is in custody since 22.06.2024.
He is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions that may be imposed by this court while considering his application for grant of bail.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail.

4. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State has vehemently opposed the application stating that there the victim is a minor aged about 16 years and there is specific allegation against the applicant.
Therefore, prayed for 2 MCRC-29338-2024 rejection of the application.

5. Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and no objection was raised by the parents of the victim before the trial court as is reflected from the impugned order and the fact that there is specific allegation against the present applicant, this Court is not inclined to allow this bail application at this stage.

6. The application is hereby rejected.
